tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background for site, web app and dashboard.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, popovers and tables sitting on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Large grouping panels and feature blocks behind cards; disabled control fill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `brand-tint`, `sky-tint`, `accent` and `sky`. Also the fill of the dark feature block.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and mono labels on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card outlines only. Not for control edges.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders; 3:1 or more on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, selected states and the lead chart series. Text on it uses `on-brand`. As text it reads on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of `brand` buttons.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on `brand` and `brand-hover`.

tokens.name: on-brand-veil
tokens.usage: Hover fill of buttons drawn on a `brand` or `ink` block (variant `on-brand`). Lets text and border stay `on-brand`.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Lavender feature blocks, hero panels and chart fills. Text on it is `ink`, never `brand`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Warm highlight: key numbers, one accent block per screen, alerts of interest. Text on it uses `on-accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text placed on `accent`.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Secondary highlight block for stats and trust numbers. Text on it uses `on-sky`.

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: Text placed on `sky`.

tokens.name: sky-tint
tokens.usage: Light-blue panels, hero backgrounds and soft chart areas. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Light-yellow friendly highlight: one panel or tile per screen, callouts, badges of good news. Text on it uses `on-sun`.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text placed on `sun`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Green for OK: approved, reconciled, rescued. Text and icons on `success-tint`, `surface` and `surface-raised`. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Yellow for challenge, medium risk and needs review. Text and icons on `warning-tint`, `surface` and `surface-raised`. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Light-yellow background of challenge and medium-risk badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Red for KO: declined, failed, fraud, high risk. Text and icons on `danger-tint`, `surface` and `surface-raised`. Always paired with a word or message.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of KO, fraud and high-risk badges and inline error messages.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 3px focus outline with 2px offset; 3:1 or more on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `brand-tint`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed backdrop behind Modal, Sheet and the 3DS challenge overlay. Derived from `ink`, never slate or navy.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Soft translucent azure fill of the lead series: bars and areas. Always pair with `chart-1-line` as a 1.5px outline and label values directly.

tokens.name: chart-1-line
tokens.usage: Solid azure for the lead series: lines, dots and bar outlines. 3:1 or more on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Soft translucent violet fill of the second series: bars and areas. Always pair with `chart-2-line` as a 1.5px outline and label values directly.

tokens.name: chart-2-line
tokens.usage: Solid violet for the second series: lines, dots and bar outlines. 3:1 or more on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Light-blue area fills and third series; never the only mark that carries meaning.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Highlight for thresholds, alerts and anomalies; use one per chart.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline on the marketing site.

styles.name: stat-sm
styles.usage: Big numbers in stat tiles below 900px wide.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles in the web app and dashboard.

styles.name: label-mono
styles.usage: Badges, chart legends and section eyebrows, set in uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls and badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between form label and field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related items; card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of large blocks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections in the app.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on the site.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero vertical padding on the site.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on the site and the dashboard; centre it with `space-5` side padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dashboard panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Stat tiles and feature blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and avatar frames.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Dashboard cards and floating product mockups.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating layers above the page: Modal, Popover, DropdownMenu, Sheet, Toast, Tooltip. Always with a `border`.
